releases.name: Web Press Simulator 2026-09-25
releases.body: Created the web press simulator. It showed press settings, dryers, alarms, and preventive maintenance, in English and French.

jobs.description: Private training simulator for a web printing press, in English and French.

releases.name: Diamond Driller 2026-09-25
releases.body: Created the spot pattern maker. Added the 447 color standard and smaller patterns and pages. Sheets now fill exactly with a centered crop and a true size PDF. Millimeter rulers now run along the top and left edges.

jobs.description: Turns a picture into a numbered DMC color drill pattern with printable pages.

releases.name: Signal Snapshot 2026-09-28
releases.body: Created the signal snapshot panel with live, graded, and report views.

jobs.description: Panel that shows live, graded, and report views of market signals.

releases.name: Signal Snapshot Backend 2026-09-28
releases.body: Created the signal snapshot backend. It takes in price bars, detects patterns, logs snapshots, grades them, and serves a report. A small deploy fix followed the same day.

jobs.description: Backend that checks price bars for patterns, logs signals, and grades them.

releases.name: Territory Control 2026-09-29
releases.body: Created the first version of the territory control war game.

jobs.description: First version of a map based turn strategy game that became Topo Wars.

releases.name: Note Note Note 2026-09-29
releases.body: Added lines, a mind map, undo for deleted notes, and storage protection. Line colors now show in the top bar while connecting.

releases.name: Note Note Note 2026-09-28
releases.body: Created shaped sticky notes on a picture with notes inside notes. Added huge grids, database storage, picture adjust, and DMC colors. Touching notes of the same color now join. Added an Out button and a pinch out to leave a note. Added a search menu, and text now continues into the square below.

jobs.description: Turns a picture into colored squares you group into notes and link with lines.

releases.name: Pajamastan Warrants 2026-10-02
releases.body: First deploy of the warrants page and the backend that keeps its docket current.

jobs.description: Public record page listing the active warrants docket with new entries flagged.

releases.name: Paycheck Hub 2026-10-02
releases.body: First deploy of the paycheck hub.

jobs.description: Splits a paycheck into bills and spending buckets with fixed rules.

releases.name: Topo Wars 2026-10-03
releases.body: Added a commander aura and a howitzer fortress. Computer opponents now scout and grab land, and up to four can play at once. Added tanks, mine drones, a chinook, and two kill grenades. The enemy commander now hides with no last seen marker.

releases.name: Topo Wars 2026-10-01
releases.body: Added a bomber with a send bomber button. You can keep playing zombies, and tapping hitches and boards units.

releases.name: Topo Wars 2026-09-30
releases.body: Added offline play, supply crates, and structures on buildings. Added zombie mode and a machine gun nest. Added buildings, a howitzer, piece pictures, and a gun range square. Placing several pieces in a row and group orders now work. The setup panel is cleaner.

releases.name: Topo Wars 2026-09-29
releases.body: Added territory income, jeep drivers, commanders that ride, and road and tread fixes. Added play a friend, surrender, structures, paved roads, and join by code. Pieces, marks, barricades, and structures now face the right way. You can keep playing after a win.

jobs.description: Turn based war game played on real map terrain with computer, friend, and zombie modes.
Tap pancakes before they burn in a growing grill game.

releases.name: Hackercons Roulette 2026-10-04
releases.body: Created the clip player, version two, with stumble and guess modes.

jobs.description: Plays random short clips from hacker conference talks with a guessing mode.

releases.name: Hackercons Roulette API 2026-10-04
releases.body: Created the clip catalog backend. A fix the same day made the random pick truly random.

jobs.description: Catalog service that serves random playable conference clips to the player.
